Name: Seasonal Fairy Farmer
Author: lhijazi
Description:
[size=4]This mod replaces the third shirt in the character creator with a fairy-themed vest with wings, that dynamically changes palette each season![/size]

[size=3]
Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]

[size=4]Installation: Just unzip de downloaded file and drag/drop into the mod folder just like any other content patcher mod[/size]

[size=3]This mod is compatible with other shirt replacers, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1354]like my own![/url][/size]

Downloads.Description: Not tested but should be compatible with 1.4!

Manifest.Name: Seasonal Fairy
